judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing acceptance tests and updating one spec file, completely failing to implement the actual production code changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is untouched and still uses `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage`, the newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when `npm test` is run. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature to clarify `totalUsage`, did not add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry as required by the acceptance criteria, and left an artifact `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. While the acceptance tests themselves and the `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` update are well-structured and target the right behavior, the core implementation is missing.
